title: Target record (runtime Target Registry, AC-02 V1)
$comment: @akili-spec changes/cicd-executor-poc design 5.3, 6.3, DD-23, DD-25; requirements FR-02, FR-21; architecture-change-02 V1. One item of the DynamoDB table cicd-registry-<stage> (TARGET#{targetId} / META), validated without its key attributes (the adapter removes pk and sk before validation, task R-3). Only what is needed to locate the server, connect securely and run the authorized script. Values are inline and non-secret; credentialRef is a Secrets Manager reference name, never a value, and its Executor secret prefix is enforced by the onboarding tool (task R-7). additionalProperties false: any other field (a credential value, a deployment model field, a command) is rejected. Cross-field rules a schema cannot express are not encoded here.

targetId.$comment: Semantic id; equals the item key and the request's targetId (design 6.1).

project.$comment: Semantic id (e.g. prms, star, marlo, clarisa); descriptive only.

environment.$comment: dev in the PoC (design 6.3); descriptive, never compared with the request.

hostKey.$comment: Pinned host key: one or more OpenSSH public-key lines (<type> <base64> [comment]); mandatory and strict, never StrictHostKeyChecking=no (design 6.3, FR-12).

credentialRef.$comment: Secrets Manager secret name of the SSH credential; read only at connect time, kept in memory only. The name charset excludes ARNs (no ':').

deployScript.$comment: Absolute path of the deploy script installed on the target (design 6.3, 6.5): no '.' or '..' segment, no trailing slash, no arguments, no whitespace or shell metacharacters. Trusted registry configuration, never taken from the request.

sourceRepositoryId.$comment: GitHub repository_id of the single repository allowed to deploy this target; compared with the IAM-enforced role session name in the SQS SenderId (option A, DD-25).

version.$comment: Optimistic version for the onboarding tool's conditional writes; recorded in the execution snapshot.
